pages.title: A Portable Identity Credential
pages.text: The Spirit Drive does not stack. Use an unclaimed drive in the air to bind it; its tooltip shows the latest owner name. Another player cannot force a claimed drive to rebind.

pages.title: Not Fuel by Itself
pages.text: Inside a compatible fuel slot, the drive pays from its online owner's personal storage: one ImmortalPower first, then one TruePower if needed. A machine waits and retries when funds are absent. The drive itself is never consumed.

pages.title: Who Owns the Machine
pages.text: Inside a personal realm, the realm owner takes priority. Only outside such a realm can the drive owner supply the binding. With neither reliable source, the machine remains unbound. Turning off Xianqiao output never disables an inserted drive's fuel substitution.

pages.title: Compatible Devices
pages.text: Immortal Furnaces, Simulated Reincarnation Furnaces, Simulated Spirit Fields and all Xianeng Crystals accept the drive. Inventory, output and the drive survive launcher changes. Legacy session UUIDs migrate in place only when ownership evidence is reliable.
